verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an API with more than 120 actions and an official MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence describes a sandbox, test mode, or test API key that keeps work away from production data. Grace deletion for domain tasting is a related feature that operates on real registrations, so it is not a sandbox and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
